_about: DMR (Diamond Rapids) PUNIT + Memory-Controller (MCTile) MCA sub-decode tables. PUNIT errors carry MCACOD=0x402 and encode the real cause in UC[19:16] / HW[23:20] / FW[31:24] sub-fields (decoded in that priority order, first non-zero wins). MCTile (memory) errors set bit 7 of MCACOD and carry the cause in MSCOD[31:16].
_source: Transcribed from intel-sandbox/bugninja-agents kokua/skills/mca-decoder/SKILL.md (itself sourced from diamondrapids/hiop/preSi/debug/mca_parser.py + primecode_mca.xml + mcacod.csv). Authoritative source is primecode_mca.xml in the run's prime-code release; this table is the offline fallback and may be incomplete.

mctile._note: Memory-controller error when bit 7 of MCACOD lower byte is set. MCACOD sub-fields: bit9 0=1LM/1=2LM; bits[6:4] error type; bits[3:0] channel (0xF=unspecified). Cause detail is in MSCOD[31:16].

mscod.0x0008: Transient or Correctable Patrol Scrub Read Error
mscod.0x0020: Transient or Correctable Spare Read Error
mscod.0x0080: Transient or Correctable Error for Demand or Underfill Reads
mscod.0x00A0: Uncorrectable Error for Demand or Underfill Reads
mscod.0x00B0: Poison was read from memory when poison was disabled in memory controller
mscod.0x0106: WDB Read Persistent Corr ECC Error
mscod.0x0200: DDR CAParity or WrCRC or MCR CRC Error
mscod.0x0834: MC Tracker RDCMP RF parity error
mscod.0x0836: MC Tracker WRCMP RF parity error
